reuse.why: Builds on the tree's getMonthFillCategories/isMonthFillCategory/averageToBudgetAmount and the shared extractTagsFromText; the new action reuses them instead of writing its own query.

duplication.why: Exclusion sets are defined once (getManagedCategoryIds), but copyPreviousMonth re-applies the managed-id exclusion beside isMonthFillCategory, mirroring what getMonthFillCategories does.

placement.why: All selection logic stays in budget/actions.ts with the month-fill helpers; the managed-category exclusion lives in getMonthFillCategories rather than in the predicate, which forces copyPreviousMonth to apply it separately.

scope.why: Edits are limited to month-wide actions, the new method registration, tests and a release note.

maintainability.why: Rules are named and centralised; the predicate now carries a scope and a boolean flag with an unobvious null-group rule, and one caller composes the rule by hand.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions go through isMonthFillCategory; copyPreviousMonth uses the shared getManagedCategoryIds rather than its own query.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated managedIds check in copyPreviousMonth is an explicit second application, not a disguised copy.

abstraction_drift.where: isMonthFillCategory/getMonthFillCategories gained includeHiddenCategories and a 'visible' && group_hidden === null branch replacing the 'all' scope; copyPreviousMonth applies managedIds outside the shared selection.
